questions.topic: CGST Section 95 — meaning of advance ruling
questions.q: A registered business asks the Authority for Advance Ruling how a specified GST provision applies to a supply it proposes to undertake. Which description best fits an advance ruling under Section 95?

questions.topic: CGST Section 103 — persons bound by an advance ruling
questions.q: A State Authority for Advance Ruling gives a ruling to Company A. Another unrelated company in the same State carries on a similar business. Under Section 103(1), who is ordinarily bound by that ruling?
o: Every registered person in the State
Company A and the concerned or jurisdictional officer in respect of Company A
Every GST officer in India for all taxpayers
Only the accountant who filed the application
questions.e:
Under Section 103(1), a ruling of the Authority or Appellate Authority binds the applicant who sought it and the concerned or jurisdictional officer in respect of that applicant. It is not automatically a universal precedent for every unrelated taxpayer; the Act also recognises that changed law, facts or circumstances affect binding force.

questions.topic: Article 200 — Governor's action on State Bills

Article 200 sets out the Governor's options when a State Bill is presented: assent, withhold assent, reserve it for the President, or return a Bill other than a Money Bill for reconsideration. The Governor does not certify Union Money Bills or refer Bills to the Election Commission.

The country's physical export volume must double
A given quantity of exports can purchase more imports
The exchange rate must become fixed
